title: flashSpec operation
description: A flash SPECIFIED by a pair other than (T, P): (P, H), (P, S), (T, V/F) or (P, V/F), solved by ONE home (flashState::specifiedFlash) -- the one a unit that needs such a state is to call; none does yet: adiabaticFlash, valve, compressor and turbine keep their own searches. Every trial state is ONE isothermal flash (its stability test and supercritical discard included), priced on the energy report's own surface (hOfState / sOfState; the entropy's liquid leg is the partner of the liquid enthalpy). A pure fluid inside its latent jump lands on the saturation plateau (T = Tsat, the vapour fraction by the lever rule) — the wet isentropic expansion a single-phase vapour model cannot see. A specification no state satisfies inside the search window REFUSES by name; nothing is clamped. Convergence is solver/Convergence.H's one decision (the degenerate one-equation case: the raw residual, said so).

composition.title: Feed (moles, normalised)
composition.description: The ONE overall composition the state is a property of.

spec.title: The specification
spec.description: `pair` names the two variables fixed; the held one (P, or T for TVF) and the specified value (H, S or vaporFraction) — or, for PH / PS, `targetFrom { T; P; }`, the H or S of a reference state of the same feed. Declaring the pair's UNKNOWN is refused (use `seed`).

targetFrom.title: Reference state whose H or S is the target

seed.title: Where the search starts (T, or P for TVF)

window.title: Search window
window.description: Defaults 50-1500 K and 100 Pa - 1000 bar. A target the window cannot reach is refused naming both ends.

convergence.title: Convergence controls (the OpenFOAM triple)
convergence.description: Defaults per pair: 1e-6 J/mol (PH), 1e-9 J/(mol K) (PS), 1e-11 on the vapour fraction; maxIter 100. Announced when defaulted.
